model.name: GCN
model.reference: Weber et al. 2019, Anti-Money Laundering in Bitcoin

Weber_2019_GCN.note: Original paper does not use class-balanced loss

notes: Loss was still decreasing at epoch 200 — longer training expected to close the gap to 0.41.
Class-balanced loss inverts the precision/recall tradeoff vs the paper. For AML, false negatives are more costly than false positives, so high recall is desirable — but worth ablating both settings.
Training takes 8s on full graph — GPU is barely loaded. Could afford 1000+ epochs or larger hidden dim.
Next: train GAT and EvolveGCN baselines (week 2), then build first launderer agents (week 3+).
